notes: §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.2 (as Amendment 1 replaced it) admits four subscripts: ALL, integer-1, data-name-2 [{+|-} integer-2] and index-name-1 [{+|-} integer-3]. The grammar (subscriptItem) and SubscriptBinder.BindPosition bind the 2023 arithmetic-expression superset at every edition; the 1985 format is the edition gate VisitSubscriptPart with IsCobol85Subscript, which at --std 85 refuses with COBOL0900 every subscript that is not one term (a numeric literal or a data reference) or a data reference, one + or -, and a numeric literal. Probed at 85: (+1), (N OF G + 1), (IX - 1), a subscripted condition-name and FUNCTION SUM (NE (ALL)) compile and run right; N * 2, N + M, 1 + N, 1 + 1, (N), N + 1 + 1, - N, IX + N, IX * 2, N ** 2 and FUNCTION LENGTH (M) are refused. PARTIAL because the gate tests the SHAPE of the expression, never the operand: (1) any numeric literal passes as integer-1, integer-2 or integer-3, so ELEM (1.5), ELEM (N + 1.5) and ELEM (IX + 1.0) compile (§1985:III.2: "Where the term 'integer' appears in the general formats, integer must be a numeric literal which is an integer, and it must be neither signed nor zero unless explicitly allowed by the rules for that format."); (2) a signed or zero offset passes (N + +1, N - -1, N + 0), and a zero integer-1 (ELEM (0)); (3) any data reference passes as data-name-2, so the subscripted subscript ELEM (IE (2)) and ELEM (IE (2) + 1) compile, where §1985:III.2 says "'data-name' represents a word which must not be reference-modified, subscripted, or qualified unless specifically permitted by the rules of the format" and §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR5 permits only "Data-name-2 may be qualified". The witness runs ELEM (1), (N + 1), (IX + 3) and (N - 1) only. kb/Work PB5074 holds mechanism (1) for SR5 and SR6 (IsCobol85Subscript passes any numeric literal); the format row, the signed or zero offset and the subscripted data-name-2 are in no note.

next.reason: Amendment 1 (X3.23a-1989, its change for page IV-21: 'replace the general format with the following') added ALL to the 1985 format, so ALL is no longer a 2023 addition: §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.2 takes ALL, integer-1, data-name-2 [{+|-} integer-2] or index-name-1 [{+|-} integer-3]. §2023:8.4.2.3.2 takes ALL, 'arithmetic-expression-1' or index-name-1 [{+|-} integer-1]. Every 1985 form is an arithmetic expression or the index form and keeps its meaning, but 2023 accepts subscripts the 1985 format refuses: any arithmetic expression (A(I * 2), A(I + J), a subscripted or non-integer operand) where 1985 allows only an integer literal or a data-name with a literal offset, that data-name 'a numeric elementary item representing an integer' (§1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR5). The compile-time refusal of a non-integer subscript became a run-time exception condition: 'If the evaluation of arithmetic-expression-1 does not result in an integer, the EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT exception condition is set to exist' (§2023:8.4.2.3.4 GR1). Where ALL may be written is the requirement of §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR7 ('The subscript ALL may be used only when the subscripted identifier is used as a function argument'), carried by §2023:8.4.2.3.3 SR6, not this format's, so SR-8.4.2.3.3-6 is left out.
